image_description: A vintage audio cassette tape lying on a textured carpet surface. The cassette has a translucent grey plastic shell with a paper label featuring red and green stripes. To the left of the cassette is a tangled black cable, and above it are two small white rectangular cards or tickets.

artifact_observations.location: Entire image, specifically the label text and background texture
artifact_observations.reasoning: The image suffers from significant softness/lack of sharpness. Fine details on the cassette label are melted into illegible blobs rather than crisp text. The background carpet texture lacks high-frequency detail.
The cable appears somewhat fused and lacks distinct strand definition, looking more like a solid black ribbon than a twisted wire.
The white rectangular objects contain markings that mimic text layout but resolve into nonsensical smudges upon inspection, typical of AI-generated text artifacts.
